title: Nan Cup: snappier kart steering
kaylee: Her kart turns the moment she pushes, leans and kicks up dirt into the turn, and keeps its line when her finger sits still.
questions: Steering: right, too twitchy, or too slow? (Change the Steering and Snap knobs in the feel lab and tell me the numbers.)
Camera: does it swing behind her enough on a hard turn?

pictures.title: Before and now, the same push
pictures.caption: Now she starts moving in 0.18 s instead of 0.42 s. A tap moves her about 1.5 m and she stays there; holding the push swings her right across the road.
